newsitem.title: USA: Stocks rise sharply as Greenspan eases market fears.
newsitem.headline: Stocks rise sharply as Greenspan eases market fears.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed sharply higher Wednesday after Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's latest comments seemed to ease fears the central bank might be planning some action to slow the stock market's rise.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed up 93.13 points, or 1.36 percent, at 6,945.85. In the broader market, advancing issues beat declines 15-9 on active volume of 531 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
